title: About
text:
I am originally from Kigali, Rwanda. I earned a Bachelor of Science in Information Systems and Technology from United States International University-Africa in Nairobi, Kenya, where I graduated Cum Laude.
Before starting the Master of Data Science program at the University of British Columbia, I worked as a Global Graduate Trainee in Customer Value Management at MTN Rwandacell. In that role, I contributed to reports and dashboards, customer engagement analysis, and data-driven business insights.

title: Carine Ishimwe

About Me
Before beginning my Master of Data Science, I worked as a Global Graduate Trainee in Customer Value Management at MTN Rwandacell, where I contributed to reports and dashboards, customer engagement analysis, and data-driven business insights.
I am also the founder of Unity Lens, an initiative exploring how artificial intelligence and virtual reality can be used for historical preservation and peace education.

title: About
text:
Why Data Science
My interest in data science comes from wanting to understand how data can be transformed into useful insights that support better decisions.
During my time at MTN Rwanda, I became especially interested in how analytics can be used to understand customer behaviour and improve business outcomes. At UBC, I hope to deepen my skills in data science, machine learning, and artificial intelligence.

title: About
text:
Projects and Interests
I am the founder of Unity Lens, an initiative that explores how artificial intelligence and virtual reality can be used to preserve Rwanda’s history and support peace education.
I am interested in building technology and AI projects that address meaningful real-world challenges while combining data, storytelling, and social impact.
